attributes.description:
Join us for FIVE days of energizing fun!
 
Children entering kindergarten through 5th grade in the fall--as well as 4- & 5-year-olds--are invited to participate in PLCC’s Sports Camp July 29-August 2. We’ll meet each day from 9:00am-12:00pm for energetic music, Bible lessons, and sports instruction from college athletes. Students can choose which sport they want to learn or improve their skills in: basketball, soccer or cheerleading. We will also have an art option (space is limited)!

  • For 4- and 5-year-olds, we have a special Kickstart program, which is an intro to sport skills and movement!
  • Every participant receives small-group instruction and encouragement as well as a cool SWAG bag!
  • Spaces are limited, so we encourage you to register early to save your child’s place.
Registration includes: Professional leadership from Base Sports; instruction from highly trained college athletes; healthy snacks; SWAG bag including t-shirt, water bottle, and fun treats!

Cost:
Early Bird Price (through April 30) - $110 for first child
Starting May 1 - $125 for first child
$10 discount for each additional child
attributes.name: Sports Camp

attributes.description:
TWO WAYS TO PARTICIPATE!
  1. MomCo Monday Meetups (full membership)
  2. MomCo Social Meetups only
Here at MomCo at Pine Lake, we gather and support moms. The MomCo (short for Mom Community) is a group of women, with children of all ages, going through life together. We believe in the simple but revolutionary idea that remarkable things happen when moms come together. If you are a mom with a child at home, of any age, we have a place for you!

See upcoming dates
